competitorMonitor.description: Cluega connects deeply to Meta’s ad archive and TikTok’s ad-library official APIs, syncing the world’s newest creatives in scheduled daily increments. reportGenerator.headline: Once Cluega produces insights, the system delivers them to your client instantly.
reportGenerator.description: Every night during off-peak, the Cluega engine starts on its own: it pulls your “user intent feature vector” and runs high-speed vector search across the past 24 hours of new creatives in the global ad market. Creatives with similarity > 0.85 and standout performance wait for you at dawn — delivered through a polished WhatsApp card that wakes your day with a “delayed surprise.”

statement.headline: Competitor intel shouldn’t die
statement.headlineAccent: the moment you close the window
statement.description: Today’s ad managers spend hours searching across platforms by hand — and the “winning creative” they find is already stale by last night. TikTok and Meta’s ad markets refresh millions of creatives every 24 hours. Keeping up by hand is no longer possible.

approach.headline: Insight is no longer a one-off,
approach.headlineAccent: it’s a flywheel that sharpens every day
approach.description: Cluega’s three chains form a self-reinforcing flywheel: the more creatives you store and the more precisely you right-click away the irrelevant, the deeper the AI reads your “user intent vector” — so tomorrow’s winners are sharper than today’s. Not a tool, but a competitor-intelligence radar that grows on its own.

setup.headline: Up and running in minutes
setup.description: Pick the industries and regions you care about, set your “intent vector” dimensions, and the Cluega dawn engine gets to work. No scrapers, no data engineers — tomorrow morning you’ll get your first “delayed surprise.”

modelPicker.headline: Pay only for the moment you truly see the value
modelPicker.description: We believe you shouldn’t be charged until you see “yesterday’s freshly launched competitor winners” with your own eyes. Cluega runs on Outcome-as-a-Service (OaaS) pricing — see the value first, then decide whether to unlock.

integrations.headline: Seamlessly connect to the world’s ad APIs, so AI agents run autonomously in the background
integrations.description: Cluega connects directly to official APIs like Meta’s ad archive and TikTok Creative Center, plus your existing data platforms and social media, so the AI agent makes full use of compliant data to generate sharper competitor insight.

knowledge.headline: Trained on your market
knowledge.description: Upload industry reports, competitor files or brand guides, and Cluega absorbs them into your “user intent vector” right away — so the winners the dawn engine finds stay tightly relevant to your business.

align.headline: Insights that sharpen the more you use them
align.description: Define exactly what matters most to you. Every right-click delete of “not interested” is a negative-feedback signal; the AI keeps calibrating your “intent vector,” filtering noise and surfacing what counts — recommendations that sharpen over time.

secure.headline: Safeguarding your data end to end
secure.description: Enterprise-grade encryption and strict access controls — plus official API authorization and zero scraping risk — keep your competitor insight and intelligence running in a fully secure, compliant environment.

team.headline: Your competitor library,
team.headlineAccent: the more you use it the better it knows you
team.description: The “Insights” board is your competitor-intelligence hub. Every auto-filed creative shows up as an ad card; your team can review, right-click to delete, or one-tap unlock new creatives — and every action teaches the AI your taste.
